items.title: Accept or decline the offered daycare place
items.quote: Bitte sagen Sie uns binnen 12 Arbeitstagen ab dem Datum dieses Briefes zu oder ab.
items.computation: The letter itself defines 'Arbeitstage' as Monday-Friday, excluding public holidays. Start: the letter is dated Thursday 19.11.2026; under §187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the triggering event (the letter's date) is not counted, so counting begins on Friday 20.11.2026 (day 1). Counting only Mon-Fri and skipping weekends (no public holidays fall in this window in NW): 20.11 Fri=1, 23.11 Mon=2, 24.11 Tue=3, 25.11 Wed=4, 26.11 Thu=5, 27.11 Fri=6, 30.11 Mon=7, 01.12 Tue=8, 02.12 Wed=9, 03.12 Thu=10, 04.12 Fri=11, 07.12 Mon=12. The 12th working day is Monday 07.12.2026, which is itself a working day so no further shift is needed.
